methodologyNotes: Roster of 11 verified current/recently-notable smart-glasses models: camera/audio wearables (Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2, Ray-Ban Meta Display, Oakley Meta Vanguard, Echo Frames Gen 3, Solos AirGo 3) and AR display glasses (Xreal Air 2 Pro, Xreal One, Xreal One Pro, Viture Pro XR, Rokid Max 2, Even Realities G1). Prices independently re-verified against official manufacturer product pages / authoritative retail listings as of 2026-06-15; secondary corroboration from major outlets (TechCrunch, Android Central, Road to VR, AppleInsider, Tom's Guide, Engadget, Laptop Mag, DCRainmaker, TechRadar, Tom's Hardware). Specs use SI units (weight in grams); battery_hours reflects continuous-use manufacturer claims (null for USB-C-powered tethered AR display glasses with no internal battery); open_ear_audio boolean (true = open-ear/speaker-in-temple, no in-ear component); camera_mp and display_resolution are null where the feature is absent. Adversarial pass corrected three prices and one release date and replaced/repaired four source URLs (details in issues). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2)
products.priceNote: MSRP, base config with standard clear lenses
products.provenance: Price ($379), up-to-8-hours typical-use battery, 12 MP camera with 3K video, and Sept 17 2025 availability confirmed via Meta newsroom and 9to5Google. IPX4 per Meta spec. Weight ~52 g per Android Central spec roundup (sources cite 50-53 g for Gen 2).

products.name: Ray-Ban Meta Display
products.priceNote: MSRP, includes Meta Neural Band wristband
products.provenance: Price ($799 incl. Neural Band), 600x600 monocular display (~20 deg FOV, up to 5000 nits), ~6 h mixed-use battery (+24 h from case), IPX4, weight 69 g, and Sept 30 2025 US launch confirmed via Meta product page and Road to VR.

products.name: Oakley Meta Vanguard
products.provenance: Price ($499), 12 MP 122-deg camera (3K video), IP67, weight 66 g, up-to-9-hours mixed use (+36 h case), and Oct 21 2025 release confirmed via TechCrunch, Road to VR, and UploadVR. Real-world reviews note lower active-use battery.

products.name: Amazon Echo Frames (3rd Gen)
products.provenance: Starting MSRP $269.99, weight ~38 g, 6 h continuous music at 80% volume (up to 14 h moderate use), IPX4, and Dec 7 2023 availability confirmed via Digital Trends review and TechRadar. No camera.

products.name: Solos AirGo 3
products.priceNote: Argon lifestyle frames from $249 (Argon 6S $299); other AirGo 3 styles from $199
products.provenance: IP67, ~10 h music / 7 h calls, ~35 g, and Argon pricing ($249 entry / $299 6S) confirmed via official Solos AirGo 3 product page and Laptop Mag review; other AirGo 3 styles start at $199. No camera. Nov 22 2023 release per Solos press release.

products.name: Xreal Air 2 Pro
products.priceNote: Current official XREAL US shop price; original 2023 launch MSRP was $449
products.provenance: Current price ($249) read directly from official XREAL US shop Air 2 Pro page (was $449 at 2023 launch). Weight 75 g, 1920x1080 per eye (Sony Micro-OLED), 46 deg FOV, 120 Hz, and Nov 2023 release confirmed via XREAL page and VRcompare. No internal battery (USB-C powered) -> battery_hours null. Water resistance not published.

products.name: Xreal One
products.priceNote: Current price (sale, reduced from $499 launch MSRP)
products.provenance: Current price ($399, regular $499), weight 82 g, 1080p Sony 0.68in Micro-OLED, 50 deg FOV, Bose audio read from official XREAL US shop page. Dec 15 2024 release per XREAL One Series press release. No internal battery (USB-C powered). Water resistance not stated.

products.name: Xreal One Pro
products.provenance: Current price ($599, regular $649), weight 87 g, 1080p Sony 0.55in Micro-OLED, 57 deg FOV, 120 Hz, Bose audio read from official XREAL US shop Air One Pro page. Apr 30 2025 general availability per XREAL press release and Tom's Hardware review. No internal battery (USB-C powered). Water resistance not published.

products.name: Viture Pro XR
products.priceNote: MSRP, standalone glasses (superseded on Viture store by Luma series; still sold via Amazon)
products.provenance: Price ($459), weight 77 g, 1920x1080 per eye (Sony Micro-OLED), 46 deg FOV, 120 Hz, and Sept 2024 release confirmed via AppleInsider review; product still listed on Amazon. NOTE: original draft source URL pointed to the newer, distinct VITURE Luma Pro XR ($499, 79 g, 1200p) -- replaced with the correct Pro XR Amazon listing. No internal battery (USB-C powered). Water resistance not listed.

products.name: Rokid Max 2
products.priceNote: MSRP on Rokid official store (standalone glasses); AR Joy 2 bundle with Station was $498-548
products.provenance: Standalone price ($309) read directly from official Rokid store. 50 deg FOV, 600 nits, 1920x1080 Micro-OLED, weight 75 g, 120 Hz confirmed via Rokid page and review coverage. Unveiled at IFA Berlin Sept 7 2024 and shipped Oct 2024 -- corrected from draft's erroneous 2025 release. No internal battery (USB-C from host). Water resistance not stated.

products.name: Even Realities G1
products.priceNote: MSRP, base config without prescription; +$150 single-vision prescription, +$100 sunglass clip
products.provenance: Base price $599 (corrected from draft's $499) confirmed via official store and Tom's Guide / Engadget / TechRadar reviews; +$150 prescription -> $749 prescription config. Weight 44 g, 640x200 green monochrome Micro-LED HUD, 25 deg FOV, 1000 nits, and June 26 2024 unveiling confirmed. No camera; no speakers (no audio hardware) -> open_ear_audio false. No published IP rating -> water_resistance null.
